column1: # Splatoon Raiders (Switch 2, update v65536). In bring-up
# Nintendo EPD's engine (sead / agl / gsys, Phive), SDK 21.4.4, NVN2 (Ampere shaders); modules main + subsdk0 (movie) + sdk.
# Packed from a dump folder (base/, updates/<version>/) with scripts/pack_dump.py. Shaders: Shader/*.Nin_Ounce_NVN2.bfsha.zs (BNSH with Ampere code).
# The Switch 2 leaves games 9 GB of its 12 GB (Donkey Kong Bananza's figure, not measured here). Unlike Bananza this NPDM declares a system resource, so virtual address memory is on.
# 256 MB in front + alias region + 256 MB stack region + heap region: a starting split, to be measured
# agl wraps its clears in render conditions on Donkey Kong Bananza; the same library here, to be confirmed on this game
